messages:
samg: Quick sync — final marketplace dry run Wed 10:00am PT. Need sign-off on press, landing page, SI test plan, and HW partner SKU mapping. Who owns microsite cutover and the rollback steps?
priya.p: I can own the microsite cutover. Will push final assets to /staging/mktplace by Tue EOD.
marco_pm: Legal had one comment on partner logo usage, looped in jennalegal. Also need clarity from NimbleEdge on SKU IDs for their edge boxes.
jenna_partners: NimbleEdge confirmed they'll send SKU CSV and vendor logos by EOD today. I'll collate into the listing template.
jennalegal: Logo guidance sent in thread earlier — prefer the condensed mark for marketplace. I'll approve final copy once the landing copy matches the approved line about trademarking.
ryan_si: I will provision the SI test tenant tomorrow morning. Can someone drop sample API keys and a minimal payload I can validate against?
devex-bot: @ryan_si here's a quick curl you can use:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/marketplace/validate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"vendor":"nimbleedge","sku":"NE-1000","region":"us-west-2"}'
```
annie_mktg: Press release draft is at https://docs.google.com/draft/marketplace-announce (comments welcome). Target publish time 10:05am PT to allow partner channels to amplify at +5m. Need legal sign-off by Tue 12:00pm.
samg: Good — embargo stays in place until publish. Jenna, can you confirm partner comms are on the same embargo?
jenna_partners: Confirmed, partners on the list agreed to embargo. I'll run a partner dry call Tue 4pm PT to walk through timeline.
ben_oncall: I'll be on-call for cutover window Wed 01:00-02:00 PT. Runbook link? Also want the CI job names for the marketplace deploy so I can watch logs.
priya.p: Runbook updated here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-cutover-2025. CI jobs: mktplace-build, mktplace-deploy-staging, mktplace-deploy-prod. Rollback step is documented (revert to v1 listing, purge CDN cache).
ops-bot: Heads-up — staging load test scheduled Tue 2pm PT. Expected 20k RPS burst simulation.
ryan_si: Perfect, I'll run SI integration tests against staging after the load test completes. Will post results in this thread.
marco_pm: Action items: (1) Priya: microsite cutover owner and assets (due Tue EOD). (2) Jenna: partner SKU CSV + logos (EOD). (3) Jenna + Annie: confirm partner embargo + dry call (Tue 4pm). (4) Jennalegal: final logo & copy sign-off (Tue 12pm). (5) Ryan: provision SI tenant & smoke tests (Wed AM). (6) Ben: on-call during cutover (Wed 01:00-02:00 PT). (7) Devex: provide sample payloads (done).
samg: Thanks — if everyone hits their ETA we should be good for Wed. :rocket: Any immediate blockers?
jenna_partners: Only open item is one NimbleEdge legal on logo variants — I'll resolve with them today.
ben_oncall: I'll add myself to the runbook rota and set up alerts for the mktplace-deploy-prod job.
annie_mktg: I'll queue the embargoed press release with partner contacts once Jennalegal confirms copy.
priya.p: I'll post a final confirmation message here Tue 11:30am PT with a pre-cutover checklist and the microsite preview link.
samg: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Marketplace dry run" Wed 10:00am PT — join link posted in calendar.
